model.name: Add folder to a model collection succeeds but the folder never appears
model.description: Tron adds a folder to a MODEL COLLECTION (e.g. diagrams) — it mints successfully but appears NOWHERE. ROOT (measured in code): the collection children derivation at server.ts:1789 (rawbin:diagram) returns ONLY ior:class:Diagram units and NEVER Folder units; and a store-only model Folder (mintRealUnit) carries parent=rawbin:diagram but NO location, so the location-based dir: merge at server.ts:1780 cannot find it either. Both paths exclude a store-only Folder parented under a model collection. SAME SHAPE AS R40.84-B / R40.87: succeeds INVISIBLY — offered<=>succeeds<=>visible is violated. c83c02f2 is only HALF fixed from Tron's point of view: the error stopped, but he still SEES NOTHING when he adds a folder to diagrams. FIX: the derivation includes parent-linked (parent=rawbin:<collection>) store-only Folder units so the folder RENDERS in the collection after add + persists.

discoverySource.mechanism: server.ts:1789 rawbin:diagram children = els.filter(ior==Diagram) only (never Folder); store-only Folder parent=rawbin:diagram has NO location so the :1780 dir: merge (location.startsWith(dirRel+'/')) cannot find it. Verified in code by req (measure-not-relay).

acceptanceCriteria.text: THE SYMPTOM (Tron literal): after add-folder on a MODEL COLLECTION (e.g. diagrams), the new folder RENDERS as a child of that collection in the model view, and PERSISTS across reload. Not 'mints successfully' — VISIBLE. offered<=>succeeds<=>appears.

gateRef.assertion: the added store-only Folder appears in the collection's children on first render and after reload

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: pre-fix behaviour (folder minted but absent from children) -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ROOT NAMED: the model-collection children derivation (server.ts:1789, rawbin:diagram) must include ior:class:Folder units parented under that collection, NOT filter to ior:class:Diagram only. A store-only Folder (mintRealUnit, parent=rawbin:<collection>) is surfaced as a child.

gateRef.assertion: children of a model collection include Folder units whose parent=that collection; a Diagram-only filter that drops them => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a Folder parented rawbin:diagram -> children MUST include it, else RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: A store-only model Folder is found by its PARENT link (parent=rawbin:diagram), NOT by a filesystem location. The location-based dir: merge (server.ts:1780) cannot find a locationless store-only Folder; the derivation must resolve parent-linked-but-locationless units, never silently drop them. (Same store-vs-view DRY law as R40.81: the unit's declared parent is the truth, not a physical dir.)

gateRef.assertion: a Folder with parent=rawbin:diagram and NO location is surfaced by parent-link; requiring a location to appear => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed a locationless parent-linked Folder -> appears, else RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The VIOLATED invariant (ties Bug c83c02f2 + R40.84-B + R40.87): if add-folder is OFFERED on a surface, a successful add is VISIBLE on THAT surface. succeeds-invisibly is a defect, not a pass. This half-fix (error stopped, folder still unseen) does NOT satisfy the Bug from Tron's point of view.

gateRef.assertion: add-folder offered on a surface + add succeeds => folder visible on that same surface; visible-nowhere => RED

Fed the pre-fix Diagram-only derivation, the gate goes RED. If the stub passes, the gate is not wired (R40.54 own-failability; isolated per R40.31).
